Frail Build.description:
💪 Build: Frail Build
Thin and delicate with visible fragility — narrow limbs, a slight frame, and proportions that suggest vulnerability or illness.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Frail Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Frail frame — thin and visibly fragile, narrow shoulders, hollow at the collarbones. Bone structure prominent under the skin, body reads delicate. Female: shoulders narrow and sloped, thin neck, small sharp jaw under the skin, a slight chest line above a hollow waist. Male: shoulders bony and narrow, thin corded neck, gaunt jaw, a flat sunken chest. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure worn thin.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
